'''Ben Reed''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 20th at [[May 2000 Meriden tournament]] on 6 May 2000, according to Andy Klema's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d682">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-07-meriden-connecticut-5-6-00d682/ meriden-connecticut-5-6-00], DeckTech (Andy "RexBanner7" Klema, 7 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-07-meriden-connecticut-5-6-00d682/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
